title: Telecom operator network (fibre + radio)
summary: Full mobile / telecom operator programme: fibre backbone, base stations (BTS/eNodeB/gNodeB), and transmission towers - not fibre-only.

lanes.label: WHY - Mandate
prompts: Why expand coverage / capacity / quality now (commercial, licence, social)?
Which markets or corridors (urban, highway, rural) are priority?

lanes.label: WHAT - Requirements
prompts: Coverage and capacity targets (sites, sectors, subscribers, throughput)?
Mix of fibre backhaul, microwave, and radio access (2G/3G/4G/5G)?
Base station and tower count, co-location vs greenfield, power and access?

lanes.label: HOW + HOW MUCH - Feasibility
prompts: Site acquisition, tower structural class, RF planning, and fibre routes?
OME for towers, BTS/RAN, fibre, power (grid/solar/generator), and civil works?
Key risks: land, security, logistics, spectrum, power, weather?

custody_types.label: Tower / mast site (title, lease, or co-location)
